market_note: Stablecoin market cap holds near $308B as Circle presses EU regulators on MiCA, warning only 3 of the top 50 stablecoins currently meet its requirements.

stablecoin_items.headline: Stablecoin market cap steady near $308B
stablecoin_items.summary: Total stablecoin supply sits around $308.45B per DeFiLlama, with USDT (~59.6% dominance) and USDC (~$72.4B) both trading essentially on peg despite a slight 0.2% pullback over 24 hours.

stablecoin_items.headline: Circle presses EU to fix MiCA rules
stablecoin_items.summary: Circle's Patrick Hansen said only 3 of the world's top 50 stablecoins currently meet MiCA requirements, calling for stronger global coordination to keep the EU competitive.

stablecoin_items.headline: Revolut users rush out of USDT before delisting
stablecoin_items.summary: Revolut clients moved $855M in a week and $2B over the past month out of USDT ahead of the token's planned delisting from the platform on August 31.

stablecoin_items.headline: GENIUS Act stablecoin rulemaking deadline lands
stablecoin_items.summary: A key U.S. stablecoin rulemaking deadline under the GENIUS Act arrived this week, coinciding with the July 28-29 FOMC meeting, adding fresh regulatory clarity pressure on issuers.

hack_items.headline: AFX-powered bridge drained of $24.15M
hack_items.summary: Attackers compromised private keys from five validators on an Arbitrum bridge to hit quorum and move funds; the 200-second challenge window passed with no challenge filed.

hack_items.headline: Triple-A treasury drain revised up to $11.8M
hack_items.summary: Payments firm Triple-A confirmed unauthorized access to hot wallets across TRON, Ethereum, TON and Solana, with funds still being actively drained 31 hours after first outflows.

hack_items.headline: Solido Money hack strips 293.7M SUPRA tokens
hack_items.summary: A two-wave attack on Solido Money drained 293.7M SUPRA tokens; on-chain tracing points to a large portion moving toward a suspected Gate.io deposit address.

hack_items.headline: H1 2026 sets record: $1.1B stolen across 212 exploits
hack_items.summary: Blockaid's H1 2026 report tallies 212 verified exploits, with DPRK-linked groups tied to the KelpDAO (~$292M) and Drift Protocol (~$285M) incidents alone.
